description: Tabular data display. Built on Bootstrap's `.table` (striped, hover, bordered, sized, responsive, active row) and extended by the exos theme: column headers render as small bold uppercase secondary text, first/last cells inherit the card horizontal spacing, plus exos-specific layouts `.table-all-side-bordered` (full grid border) and `.table-card-layout` (table rendered as a card surface with an absolutely-positioned caption and a `.btn-table-card-layout` action slot).

always: Wrap a table in a `<div class="table-responsive">` when it can overflow narrow viewports.
Use semantic <thead>, <tbody>, <th>, <td> elements; column headers go in <thead> as <th>.
never: Do not apply the row-level `.table-active` class to a <table> element — it highlights a single <tr> or cell.
Do not hand-style header cells; the theme already renders <thead> th as small bold uppercase secondary text.
Do not use `striped-list`/`solid-list` here — those are list-group modifiers, not table classes.

a11y: Give every column/row header a `scope` attribute (scope="col" on <thead> th, scope="row" on row-header th).
Provide a <caption> (or aria-label/aria-labelledby on the table) describing the table's contents; `.table-card-layout` styles the <caption> as the card title.
Keep data in real table semantics so screen readers announce row/column relationships.

on.note: Bootstrap built-in; highlights the hovered row.

bordered.note: Bootstrap built-in; borders on all sides of every cell.

borderless.note: Bootstrap built-in; removes all cell borders.

all-side.note: Exos-specific; adds left/right outer borders and a bottom border, building a fully enclosed grid.

card.note: Exos-specific; renders the table on a white card surface with shadow, an absolutely-positioned <caption> title and a `.btn-table-card-layout` top-right action slot.

root.note: Optional scroll wrapper; omit for tables that always fit.

children.note: Describes the table; styled as the title under `.table-card-layout`.
Add `.table-active` to a single <tr> (or cell) to mark it selected/active.
